notes: Grid 3 x 4 lines; 60 joints, 48 columns, 68 beams.
Fixed supports at the top of the footings, 1.5 m below ground-floor level (assumed); plinth beams at ground-floor level carry the ground-floor walls.
Walls: burnt clay brick 20 kN/m3 plus 0.5 kN/m2 plaster (IS 875 Part 1), less door and window areas; parapets 1 m on roof and terrace edges.
Partitions between grid lines: slab load of at least one third of their weight per metre, minimum 1 kN/m2 (IS 875 Part 2 cl. 3.1.2).

Imposed loads 2 (rooms), 3 (corridors, stairs, stores), 1.5 kN/m2 (roofs): National Building Code of India 2016 (SP 7:2016), Vol 1, Part 6 Section 1, cl. 3.3.1, Table 1 (i)(a), National Building Code of India 2016 (SP 7:2016), Vol 1, Part 6 Section 1, cl. 3.4.1, Table 2 (i).
Stair: 8.031 kN/m2 on plan (0.15 m waist, steps, finish) over the stair cell.
Finishes 1 kN/m2 on floors, 1.5 kN/m2 on roofs (practice).
Slab 125 mm: shortest-side span up to 3.21 m, span/depth 28 (IS 456 cl. 24.1 Note 2, x 0.8 for Fe 500).

Seismic: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016, Z = 0.36 (National Building Code of India 2016 (SP 7:2016), Vol 1, Part 6 Section 1, Annex K (cl. 5.3.4.2)), R = 5 (SMRF, IS 13920 detailing), I = 1.0, medium soil (assumed); 100% + 30% orthogonal combinations (cl. 6.3.4.1).

IS 875 (Part 3):2015 wind: Vb 50 m/s, k1 1.0, k2 terrain category 3 (Table 2, assumed), k3 1.0, k4 1.0; pd = Kd Ka Kc pz with Kd 0.9, Ka 1.0, Kc 0.9; net Cp 1 (Table 5: windward +0.7, leeward -0.3); Vb source: National Building Code of India 2016 (SP 7:2016), Vol 1, Part 6 Section 1, Annex C (cl. 4.4.2).
